subject.title: Feature request: api.callGatewayMethod() for inter-plugin communication

question: Should OpenClaw expose plugin-to-plugin Gateway method calls to external plugins, and if so should that be raw dispatch, an allowlisted request API, or a typed service/capability contract?
rationale: The requested surface changes the public Plugin SDK and Gateway authorization boundary; automation cannot safely choose the permanent security model or API shape.

options.title: Design a narrow authorized contract
options.body: Expose only approved methods or typed capabilities with caller attribution, explicit authorization, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep trusted/route-scoped dispatch only
options.body: Decline ordinary external plugin-to-plugin Gateway calls and direct plugins to existing HTTP route, manifest, or capability seams.

options.title: Allow raw Gateway dispatch
options.body: Expose a generic method string caller and accept the larger security and compatibility surface as a maintainer-owned product decision.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow authorized contract
recommendation.body: Expose only approved methods or typed capabilities with caller attribution, explicit authorization, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the current trusted Gateway runtime seam and is the clearest recent decision owner for this boundary.
